scope: Director-only source planning repair. No runtime/Kit/actors/GPU changes by this author. Parent owns fresh actual UI acceptance.

nativePlanProof.basis: native navmesh query with actual agent dimensions; not observed arrival

actualFailure.limits: This was a genuine planning-deadline failure with normal restoration before crossing. A future signal window was not actual permission to cross. No analytic/native completion is claimed.

repair.latch: Once per original awaiting-walk phase; original phase start and original180s episode start retained. Polls/slowdowns never relatch or extend it.
repair.crossingReserve: Maximum of any valid positive current native-path-with-margin SIM/rate+existing8s margin and published crossing wall estimate. Actual runtime computes its path from the locked selected plan and current planning rate.
repair.allocation: min(existing115s signal ceiling, max(0, original180 total minus time before WAIT minus pinned crossing reserve minus cleanup reserve))
repair.fallback: Missing/invalid positive crossing duration keeps the old finite wait/rate+margin fallback; no full-slack expansion without a reserve.
repair.liveEntryGuards: Actual displayed/traffic phase, full native path, cohort, real curb arrival, unchanged0.35m arrival tolerance and CURRENT remaining-original-budget fit remain authoritative. No forced WALK or timer completion.
repair.exposedFields: pacingBudget.walkWaitPlan and walk-wait-budget-latched.planningComponents hold actual ratio, initial wait estimate, original available time, crossing/cleanup reserves, ceiling and allocated fixed wait.

predictionForSavedFailure.basis: CPU replay of saved failure values; not actual future playback or a guarantee. Current remaining-budget and WALK checks must still pass.

independentReview: next_pipeline_perf verified exact f8a760c8/6be17c6e, independently repeated9 adaptive controls and reported no blocker. Separate review receipt will retain exact hashes.
remainingLimits: A later rendering slowdown can still make a real signal window or original overall budget unusable.
Crossing and restoration still need actual native and camera evidence independently.
The115s phase ceiling and180s original maximum remain hard limits; no repeated retry extends them.
